senses.gloss: वेह्(ऋ)वेहृ r. 1st cl. (वेहते) To resolve or endeavour diligently. Also वेह ।

वेहत् f. (-हत्) A cow miscarrying from taking the bull unseasonably.
E. वि before हन् to kill, (the embryo,) Unādi aff. अति; the radical
final rejected, and the vowel changed.

वेह्ल r. 1st cl. (वेह्लति)
 1. To go.
 2. To tremble; also वेल् and वेल्ल् ।
